contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---P]F AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE] DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, probably Trier mint, type as RIC vol. 8 page 152 no. 203. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---P]F AVG. Reverse description: Two tall Victories standing facing each other holding up wreaths, a fir branch vertical between Victories.…
